content.thinking:
The file has mojibake because the heredoc wrote UTF-8 bytes that got mangled. The empty string '' is still there. Let me just rewrite the TOKS line with ASCII-safe tokens (avoid non-ASCII in the shell heredoc to prevent encoding issues — I'll use escapes).

Let me use Python escapes: '\u03b2', '\u00df', '\u03bb', '\u65e5\u672c'.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - << 'PYEOF'
p='tests/fuzz2.py'
lines = open(p, encoding='utf-8', errors='replace').read().splitlines()
out = []
skip = False
for l in lines:
    if l.startswith('TOKS ='):
        out.append("TOKS = ['a', 'b', 'c', 'aa', 'ab', 'ba', 'bb', '\\u03b2', '\\u00df', 'x y',")
        out.append("        '\"q\"', 'Z', 'a b', '\\u03bb', '\\u65e5\\u672c', 'A', 'AB', 'a\\u0301']")
        skip = True
        continue
    if skip and l.endswith(']'):
        skip = False
        continue
    out.append(l)
open(p, 'w', encoding='utf-8').write('\n'.join(out) + '\n')
print('ok')
PYEOF
